adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly adds `Post.cook_methods` with `:raw_html` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which bypasses the normal cooking/sanitizing pipeline (`post_analyzer.cook`). This mode is then used for externally sourced content (e.g., `TopicEmbed.import` via RSS/Readability sets `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). Since RSS content is taken largely verbatim (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`), and Readability output is not shown to be sanitized by Discourse here, this can result in untrusted HTML being rendered without sanitization (XSS risk).
